business_problem: Lippert needed a better way to support AI-assisted customer support, call center coaching, and knowledge automation because surging support demand, fragmented service data, and limited visibility into call quality left support teams reactive and hard to scale.
solution_summary: Lippert uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support AI-assisted customer support, call center coaching, and knowledge automation. The implementation replaced a legacy state where surging support demand, fragmented service data, and limited visibility into call quality left support teams reactive and hard to scale. Call center conversations and support tickets move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver AI support assistant responses and agent coaching insights. Lippert improved AI-assisted customer support, call center coaching, and knowledge automation with measurable results including AI agents that pay for themselves with 106K hours saved, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
